verdict.rationale: INPI Portugal is a government IP-office portal for filing and managing patents, trademarks and designs. AI-assisted insights, such as similarity or classification suggestions, are something such a service could plausibly offer, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes any AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from user data. The prior-art search (docs-3) is a requested office service, not an in-product AI feature.
